ADVISOR SUPPLEMENTAL LOCAL-CANDIDATE REWORK — BUG2017, immutable LOCALd5c98a1d16e912a8609dcee1c441b59435b33de8, preview by codex2. Read /tmp/codex2-pr2919-d5-source-preview.txt and verified immutable bootstrap/source and retirement diff against signed S2. This is NOT an attested forge verdict: published2919 still766 and existing RC F2/F3 stays. No claim/approval/hold changes. F1/case-save correction retained, all S1+S2/S3 scope intact.

F4/P1 legacy binding-provider validation: work_binding::bootstrap107-159 copies old.sequences under legacy counter lock without reading/validating present .aida/node.toml or matching old.mode. A valid node7 with Distributed node8 or Centralized provider can be converted into fresh opaque state instead of refusing; direct bootstrap can ignore malformed/missing-required legacy node fields. Validate actual present legacy records/provider binding under existing store/common/legacy locks BEFORE publishing new binding/counter or altering old data. Preserve strict legacy serde meanings (no default false person), genuine cold no-legacy bootstrap and validated partial opaque recovery. Wrong-node/Centralized/malformed legacy cases must refuse with binding/common+legacy counters/objects/oplog/refs unchanged; permanent lock sidecars are not counter spending. A genuinely supported first-use legacy state and lost/corrupt/contradictory state must not be conflated: state the supported evidence boundary instead of inventing consumption/defaulting missing identity. Existing S1 wrong-provider and missing/bound-counter refusal contracts stay intact. Add meaningful lifecycle negatives; adjust valid migration fixtures to actually supply the valid pair they claim. No global fallback/enrollment.

F5/P2 published MCP grammar regression: new optional-single-node-segment regex rejects legacy BUG-1-2-003 accepted by the previous schema and actual core reader/validate_node_id. Preserve that accepted numeric multi-segment grammar and permitted hyphenated/underscore node aliases while supporting opaque UUID nodes; reject actual cross-store separators/invalid IDs. Apply one consistent published descriptor rule across affected ID fields; derive from existing supported grammar, not an unrelated ID redesign. Add regression against actual published MCP descriptor patterns for old numeric/multi-segment aliases plus new opaque/global IDs and cross-store negatives. Do not claim server-side JSON Schema enforcement that does not exist.

F6/P2 native proof gap: capture seeded META+CLI UUID inventory BEFORE MCP add; prove it survives the MCP adds. After closing/restarting/reloading, assert actual source CLI BUG UUID has expected references target CLI FR UUID. Current after-MCP original baseline and response success alone cannot detect META loss or a relationship no-op. Extend existing test_bug2017_bootstrap.py real subprocess contract, retain HOME semantic comparisons/idempotency and stale-CAS unit regression; no new framework/mirror test.

ALIAS DISPOSITION APPROVED for signed v1: safe refusal of destructive node-local retirement (including HOME) while merge_gate preserves native old lookup/UUID and canonical agreed display is sufficient. Do not repurpose agreed_id or build an unowned general historical-alias engine. Inspected preflight is_global_id_format refusal and locked closure filter, which preserves concurrently introduced node aliases. Keep negative no-write/both-lookup tests and actual native retirement-refusal chain; old global-to-global positive writer/concurrency behavior may remain when it cannot discard a protected node alias. Describe refusal truthfully in docs/output; no claim unsupported node retirement succeeded. This resolves code1 mailbox3c6b6aa4 question, not a source-head approval.

Execution: finish these preview corrections in owned branch before normal final push, retain separate meaningful Refs BUG2017 commits and update PRbody fullS1+S2/evidence. Mainc7b must be integrated normally, noforce. One meaningful affected core module/filter Cargo run (AIDA_CARGO_TIMEOUT budget, background), existing native bootstrap contract including published-schema/UUID-edge checks plus current fast gates; no fresh broad runtime solely for old mixed touched logs. Reuse prior compiled/touched evidence honestly as prior-artifact evidence, run mandatory touched/compile if this delta actually changes shared infrastructure/>10files. No unfiltered workspace runtime/slot bypass/nested timeout. Serialize same-target tests and native build rather than consuming a second slot waiting on the same directory. Source/native source hashes remain qualified; final exact pushed-head CI/full independent delta review is mandatory. All signed S3/1742/1843 gates remain; no source-only release, real HOME flag, grant/mandate change, live service/mail/transport test or merge. Mandate expired. If already corrected since d5, show actual latest SHA/diff/evidence rather than duplicate patch/retry.
subject: d5 preview F4-F6 accepted/routed; retirement refusal sufficient for v1
